title: AlgoCloud
description: Work with AlgoCloud strategies right in the chat: create stockpicker strategies that rank a stock group, or single-asset strategies for one instrument — then backtest the saved .sqx files on their own settings and read the results.
inputPlaceholder: Describe the stockpicker or single-asset strategy you want…

starters.label: Breakout — buy new highs on rising volume
starters.prompt: Create a stockpicker strategy on the S&P 500 that buys stocks breaking out above their 50-day high on volume above its 20-day average, with an 8% stop loss and a 20% profit target, max 10 open positions. Backtest it and show me the results.

starters.label: Momentum — hold the 10 strongest stocks
starters.prompt: Create a stockpicker strategy on the Nasdaq 100 that ranks stocks by their 6-month rate of change and buys the strongest ones while they trade above their 50-day average and QQQ is above its 200-day average, max 10 open positions, exit when a stock closes below its 50-day average or hits a 10% stop loss. Backtest it and show me the equity curve.

starters.label: Mean reversion — buy oversold dips for a snap-back
starters.prompt: Create a stockpicker strategy on the S&P 500 that buys severely oversold stocks with a limit order below the previous close, and exits when price snaps back or after a few days. Backtest it and show me the results.

starters.label: Pullback — buy the dip to the 20-day average in uptrends
starters.prompt: Create a stockpicker strategy on the Nasdaq 100 that buys at market when a stock trading above its 200-day average closes below its 20-day average after being above it, ranked by 6-month rate of change, exits when the close makes a new 20-day high or after 15 bars, with a 7% stop loss, max 10 positions. Backtest it and show me the results.

starters.label: Gap — fade the opening gap down in strong stocks
starters.prompt: Create a stockpicker strategy on the S&P 500 that buys a stock when it opens at least 3% below the previous close while still trading above its 100-day average, exits at the close of the next day or on a 5% stop loss, max 10 positions. Backtest it and show me the results.

starters.label: Weekly trend — buy daily dips in weekly uptrends
starters.prompt: Create a stockpicker strategy on the S&P 500 that buys a stock when its weekly close is above its weekly 10-period average and the daily RSI(2) drops below 10, exits when RSI(2) rises above 70 or after 10 bars, with a 5% stop loss, max 10 positions. Backtest it and show me the results.
